user_profiles_deactivation_consistent.name: user_profiles_deactivation_consistent
user_profiles_deactivation_consistent.value: ("user_profiles"."status" = 'deactivated') = ("user_profiles"."deactivated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "user_profiles"."deactivated_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

suppliers_tax_id_pair.name: suppliers_tax_id_pair
suppliers_tax_id_pair.value: ("suppliers"."tax_id" IS NULL) = ("suppliers"."tax_id_normalized" IS NULL) AND ("suppliers"."tax_id" IS NULL OR char_length("suppliers"."tax_id") <= 40)

suppliers_text_lengths.name: suppliers_text_lengths
suppliers_text_lengths.value:
coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."email"), 0) <= 254 AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."phone"), 0) <= 30
        AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."address_line1"), 0) <= 200 AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."address_line2"), 0) <= 200
        AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."city"), 0) <= 100 AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."region"), 0) <= 100
        AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."postal_code"), 0) <= 20 AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."review_note"), 0) <= 2000
        AND coalesce(char_length("suppliers"."status_reason"), 0) <= 2000

suppliers_maker_checker.name: suppliers_maker_checker
suppliers_maker_checker.value: "suppliers"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NULL OR ("suppliers"."reviewed_by_user_id" <> "suppliers"."created_by_user_id" AND "suppliers"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "suppliers"."identity_changed_by_user_id")

approval_steps_activated_consistent.name: approval_steps_activated_consistent
approval_steps_activated_consistent.value: CASE "approval_steps"."status" WHEN 'waiting' THEN "approval_steps"."activated_at" IS NULL WHEN 'cancelled' THEN true ELSE "approval_steps"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL END

approval_steps_decided_consistent.name: approval_steps_decided_consistent
approval_steps_decided_consistent.value: ("approval_steps"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'returned')) = ("approval_steps"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_steps"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

approval_steps_comment_length.name: approval_steps_comment_length
approval_steps_comment_length.value: "approval_steps"."comment" IS NULL OR char_length("approval_steps"."comment") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

approval_steps_comment_only_on_decision.name: approval_steps_comment_only_on_decision
approval_steps_comment_only_on_decision.value: "approval_steps"."comment" IS NULL OR "approval_steps"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL

approval_steps_comment_required.name: approval_steps_comment_required
approval_steps_comment_required.value: "approval_steps"."status" NOT IN ('rejected', 'returned') OR "approval_steps"."comment" IS NOT NULL

purchase_requisitions_cancel_consistent.name: purchase_requisitions_cancel_consistent
purchase_requisitions_cancel_consistent.value: ("purchase_requisitions"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("purchase_requisitions"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_requisitions"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

purchase_requisitions_approved_states.name: purchase_requisitions_approved_states
purchase_requisitions_approved_states.value: "purchase_requisitions"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'closed') OR "purchase_requisitions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL

purchase_requisitions_close_consistent.name: purchase_requisitions_close_consistent
purchase_requisitions_close_consistent.value: ("purchase_requisitions"."status" = 'closed') = ("purchase_requisitions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_requisitions"."closed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_requisitions"."close_reason" IS NOT NULL)

quotations_submitted_states.name: quotations_submitted_states
quotations_submitted_states.value: CASE "quotations"."status" WHEN 'draft' THEN "quotations"."submitted_at" IS NULL WHEN 'withdrawn' THEN true ELSE "quotations"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL END

quotations_withdraw_consistent.name: quotations_withdraw_consistent
quotations_withdraw_consistent.value: ("quotations"."status" = 'withdrawn') = ("quotations"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL AND "quotations"."withdrawn_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quotations"."withdraw_reason" IS NOT NULL)

rfqs_issued_states.name: rfqs_issued_states
rfqs_issued_states.value: CASE "rfqs"."status" WHEN 'draft' THEN "rfqs"."issued_at" IS NULL WHEN 'cancelled' THEN true ELSE "rfqs"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL END

rfqs_closed_states.name: rfqs_closed_states
rfqs_closed_states.value: CASE "rfqs"."status" WHEN 'closed' THEN "rfqs"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL WHEN 'awarded' THEN "rfqs"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL WHEN 'cancelled' THEN "rfqs"."closed_at" IS NULL OR "rfqs"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL ELSE "rfqs"."closed_at" IS NULL END

rfqs_cancel_consistent.name: rfqs_cancel_consistent
rfqs_cancel_consistent.value: ("rfqs"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("rfqs"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "rfqs"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rfqs"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

rfqs_cancel_reason_length.name: rfqs_cancel_reason_length
rfqs_cancel_reason_length.value: "rfqs"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("rfqs"."cancel_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

rfqs_award_states.name: rfqs_award_states
rfqs_award_states.value: CASE WHEN "rfqs"."status" = 'awarded' THEN "rfqs"."awarded_quotation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rfqs"."awarded_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rfqs"."awarded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "rfqs"."award_min_quotes" IS NOT NULL AND "rfqs"."award_valid_quotes" IS NOT NULL AND "rfqs"."award_below_min_quotes" IS NOT NULL AND "rfqs"."award_not_lowest" IS NOT NULL ELSE "rfqs"."awarded_quotation_id" IS NULL AND "rfqs"."awarded_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "rfqs"."awarded_at" IS NULL AND "rfqs"."award_justification" IS NULL AND "rfqs"."award_rfq_required_above" IS NULL AND "rfqs"."award_min_quotes" IS NULL AND "rfqs"."award_valid_quotes" IS NULL AND "rfqs"."award_below_min_quotes" IS NULL AND "rfqs"."award_not_lowest" IS NULL END

rfqs_award_justification_length.name: rfqs_award_justification_length
rfqs_award_justification_length.value: "rfqs"."award_justification" IS NULL OR char_length("rfqs"."award_justification") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

rfqs_award_justified.name: rfqs_award_justified
rfqs_award_justified.value: NOT ("rfqs"."award_below_min_quotes" OR "rfqs"."award_not_lowest") OR "rfqs"."award_justification" IS NOT NULL

rfqs_award_rule_range.name: rfqs_award_rule_range
rfqs_award_rule_range.value: ("rfqs"."award_min_quotes" IS NULL OR "rfqs"."award_min_quotes" BETWEEN 1 AND 10) AND ("rfqs"."award_valid_quotes" IS NULL OR "rfqs"."award_valid_quotes" >= 1) AND ("rfqs"."award_rfq_required_above" IS NULL OR "rfqs"."award_rfq_required_above" >= 0)

purchase_orders_threshold_with_submissio.name: purchase_orders_threshold_with_submission
purchase_orders_threshold_with_submissio.value: "purchase_orders"."approval_threshold" IS NULL OR "purchase_orders"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL

purchase_orders_approval_round_states.name: purchase_orders_approval_round_states
purchase_orders_approval_round_states.value: "purchase_orders"."status" NOT IN ('pending_approval', 'rejected') OR ("purchase_orders"."current_approval_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("purchase_orders"."approval_reasons") > 0)

purchase_orders_approved_states.name: purchase_orders_approved_states
purchase_orders_approved_states.value: CASE WHEN "purchase_orders"."status" IN ('approved', 'issued', 'partially_received', 'received', 'closed') THEN "purchase_orders"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL WHEN "purchase_orders"."status" = 'cancelled' THEN true ELSE "purchase_orders"."approved_at" IS NULL END

purchase_orders_issued_fields.name: purchase_orders_issued_fields
purchase_orders_issued_fields.value: ("purchase_orders"."issued_at" IS NULL) = ("purchase_orders"."issued_by_user_id" IS NULL) AND ("purchase_orders"."issued_at" IS NULL) = ("purchase_orders"."receipt_tolerance_pct" IS NULL)

purchase_orders_issued_states.name: purchase_orders_issued_states
purchase_orders_issued_states.value: CASE WHEN "purchase_orders"."status" IN ('issued', 'partially_received', 'received', 'closed') THEN "purchase_orders"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL WHEN "purchase_orders"."status" = 'cancelled' THEN true ELSE "purchase_orders"."issued_at" IS NULL END

purchase_orders_close_consistent.name: purchase_orders_close_consistent
purchase_orders_close_consistent.value: ("purchase_orders"."status" = 'closed') = ("purchase_orders"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_orders"."closed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

purchase_orders_close_reason.name: purchase_orders_close_reason
purchase_orders_close_reason.value: "purchase_orders"."close_reason" IS NULL OR ("purchase_orders"."status" = 'closed' AND char_length("purchase_orders"."close_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

purchase_orders_cancel_consistent.name: purchase_orders_cancel_consistent
purchase_orders_cancel_consistent.value: ("purchase_orders"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("purchase_orders"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_orders"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_orders"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)
